en.title: Memory for VLA Policies: from EventVLA, TRACE and SAI to a 103-paper landscape — the awesome_memory_vla consolidated report
en.subtitle: Three deep dives · ten insights · design-space matrix · annotated paper list
en.preface: > This report is assembled by `scripts/build_pdfs.py` from the trends report, the three deep dives, the design-space matrix and the 103 paper notes in the repository. The authoritative version of each chapter is the corresponding Markdown file. Every number is taken from the original paper or abstract; numbers from different papers rest on different task suites and scoring rules and cannot be compared directly.
